evals.prompt: For AY 2026-27: I'm a salaried resident, total income ₹30 lakh, one house, FD interest, and ₹90,000 of §112A LTCG on listed shares, nothing else. Can I use ITR-1? What if I also had a ₹2,000 STCG from a stock sale?
expectations: Says ITR-1 is still allowed when the only capital gain is §112A LTCG of ₹1,25,000 or less
Says any STCG rules out ITR-1, so the second case needs ITR-2 at minimum

evals.prompt: Our tax engine computes final tax payable as ₹1,234.60. What amount should the return show after statutory rounding under §288B?
expectations: Ignores the paise first (₹1,234), then rounds to the nearest ten rupees, giving ₹1,230
Does not round 60 paise up to ₹1,235 before rounding to ten

evals.prompt: In my AY 2026-27 return I want credit for 25% US tax withheld on dividends from my US broker. What do I file and how much credit is allowed?
expectations: Names Form 67 as the required foreign-tax-credit statement for AY 2026-27 (Form 44 from tax year 2026-27)
Caps relief at the lower of tax paid abroad and Indian tax on that income
Reports the dividend in Schedule OS and the same rupee amount in Schedule FSI, with the credit in Schedule TR

evals.prompt: All ₹6 lakh of my short-term capital gains arose in February 2026. I paid no advance tax in June, September or December. Am I charged §234C interest for those earlier instalments?
expectations: Says the shortfall in instalments before the gain arose is excused, provided the tax on the gain is paid in the remaining instalment
Names 15 March as the remaining instalment date

evals.prompt: After merging Form 26AS and AIS, our ITR tool shows a ₹1,20,000 salary TDS twice: once with the employer's TAN and once with no TAN, same section and date. What TDS should the return claim?
expectations: Treats the two rows as one credit and claims ₹1,20,000, not ₹2,40,000
Keeps the TAN-bearing row and flags the TAN-less row as a probable duplicate
Recommends keying credits on section, date and amount rather than TAN
